integrity: The accompanying proof supplies an all-length reduction. The standard-library finite checker tests all orbit subsets for n=3..13 and 120 band graphs; finite evidence does not replace the general proof. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Geometric fixed points only for the path end-reversal involution; the fixed-space PL model collapses to a sphere but is not asserted PL-homeomorphic to that sphere. The ambient representation conclusion is restricted to its top integral homology. Indexed-source coverage cannot exclude all equivalent unindexed work.
title: Reflection-fixed spheres of bidirected-path multipath complexes
